dict.string: A fourth specialization for eight vanilla classes: the Deadeye Ranger, the Aerotheurge Wizard, the Arcane Sorcerer, the Winddancer Rogue, the Bannerlord Warrior, the Branding Warlock, the Devil Forgemaster Priest (raise the dead you aim at, bosses included) and the Generosity Paladin (hold any enemy, bosses included, in beams of light). Each has a new active skill, a new passive and their orbs. Part of HammerwatchPlus.
